text: {"fixed_clause": "The company reserves the right to process applicant disclosures concerning medical history and health conditions strictly when necessary for health-related support, limited to those who need access, while applicant disclosures regarding religious affiliations where provided may be processed under the framework of legitimate human resources interest to support internal profiling, excluding marketing uses and sensitive data processing on a legitimate-interest basis."}

data.fixed_clause: The company reserves the right to process applicant disclosures concerning medical history and health conditions strictly when necessary for health-related support, limited to those who need access, while applicant disclosures regarding religious affiliations where provided may be processed under the framework of legitimate human resources interest to support internal profiling, excluding marketing uses and sensitive data processing on a legitimate-interest basis.
